title: RegressionContextSchema
description: Output of the regression-extractor. Combines the BrowserStack Test Management inventory (which existing cases exist) with repo-derived navigation (how to reach the screen), so the sdet-plan-generator can dedup against existing coverage and attach runnable steps. Consumed inside the generator during pre-build ingest.

extraction_status.description: COMPLETE = the BrowserStack query ran and extraction_notes is empty. PARTIAL = ran but some fields could not be resolved (see notes). LIMITED = BrowserStack/MCP or the module->project map was unavailable, so coverage was NOT fully checked. Never COMPLETE when extraction_notes is non-empty. A bare empty regression_tests[] with COMPLETE means the query genuinely matched nothing; an empty list with LIMITED means the lookup could not run.

extraction_notes.description: What could not be resolved, recorded instead of guessing. Empty = clean run. A failed BrowserStack lookup, an unmapped project, or a screen with no navigation source all land here — never silently dropped.

field.description: JSON path of the unresolved field, e.g. regression_tests[3].navigation. Use 'ENVIRONMENT' for MCP/connection/mapping failures not tied to one field.

reason.description: What was checked and what was found, e.g. 'BrowserStack MCP unavailable — regression coverage was NOT checked'.

action.description: The concrete next step, e.g. 'configure the BrowserStack MCP server and re-run, or dedup manually'.

follow_up.description: NEEDS_ANSWER = someone must act before this coverage is trustworthy. WORTH_CHECKING = produced without its usual source, confirm it. FYI = no action needed.

app.description: Target app id, e.g. gojek-consumer, gojek-driver (from config).

feature_key.description: The feature being planned, e.g. OneKYC.

module_namespace.description: Modules searched — the feature's own module plus any impacted modules pulled from rfc.affected_modules.

browserstack_project.description: Resolved BrowserStack project identifier, e.g. PR-176. Resolved from the module->project map, never guessed among all projects.

resolved_folders.description: The BrowserStack folders searched within the project, resolved from the module->folder map.

regression_tests.description: Existing cases judged impacted by this change. Every entry comes from a real BrowserStack case — never invented. May be empty (see extraction_status for whether that means 'none' or 'not checked').

id.description: BrowserStack case identifier verbatim, e.g. C2879733.

case_number.description: The numeric case id without the 'C' prefix (e.g. 2879733 for C2879733). BrowserStack is the system of record; this number was carried over unchanged from TestRail during the migration, so it is the join key to the repo's @TestInfo/@GBTTestRail testCaseIds and Cucumber Examples. Each module's result-listener (e.g. CucumberExecutionListener / lumosClient.getProjectIdFromTestCaseId) resolves it to the BrowserStack project id when pushing results.

status.description: BrowserStack state, e.g. Active, Draft. Only Active cases should normally be included.

priority.description: Priority tier as reported by BrowserStack, e.g. P0, P1, P2 (human data — not enum-constrained).

is_automated.description: Whether an automated counterpart exists (true when matched to the repo by case_number).

scope.description: own_module = the feature's own module; impacted_area = pulled in via rfc.affected_modules.

source_module.description: The repo module this case was resolved through, e.g. 'gopay', 'gofood', 'driverapp'. Required when app maps to more than one module (app_id_to_modules in browserstack_project_map.json) -- e.g. gojek-consumer spans 10 modules -- so a reader can tell which one a given case belongs to.

steps.description: Execution steps. Preferred source is the repo (accurate) when an automated counterpart exists; otherwise BrowserStack's own steps, which may be weak/empty (flag via extraction_notes).

steps_source.description: Where 'steps' came from. repo = executable page-object/Gherkin steps matched by case_number; browserstack = the human-written steps as-is.

navigation.description: Ordered steps to REACH the screen under test (distinct from the case's own steps), e.g. ['Login (bypass)', 'Open deeplink gojek://gocore/settings', 'Tap Edit Profile'].

nav_source.description: Which rung of the navigation ladder produced 'navigation'. needs_answer = no deeplink, no existing test, no Figma nav map — recorded and flagged, not guessed.
